rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: BestPractices MCP server provides AI assistants with access to curated coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices for Drupal development through a plugin-based architecture. Built by abderrahimghazali, the implementation loads standards from CSV files covering Drupal security, coding conventions, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, accessibility requirements, and API design patterns, with support for full-text search, category filtering, and severity-based prioritization. The server uses an in-memory data store for fast queries and includes comprehensive standards like SQL injection prevention, proper access control implementation, and Drupal-specific best practices, making it valuable for developers who want conversational access to development guidelines during code reviews, security audits, or when learning proper Drupal development patterns.
